      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "An existing provision for doubtful debts is ₹20,000.",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Record bad debts by debiting Bad Debts and crediting Debtors, then adjust against an existing provision by debiting Provision and crediting Bad Debts.",

      "strongest_reading": "The first entry records the write-off; the second might resemble creating a provision, but the existing provision is instead debited against Bad Debts.",

    },
    {

      "premise_quote": "Bad debts A/c Dr. 1,000 31, 2017 To Sundry debtors 1,000 (Futher bad debts) (b) Provision for doubtful debts A/c Dr. 3,000 To Bad debts A/c 3,000 (Bad debts adjusted against the provision",
